q: Which block gives most of the analgesia for ankle surgery?
why: The sciatic nerve supplies most of the ankle and foot below the knee.

q: Which extra block covers the medial ankle?
why: The saphenous nerve supplies skin over the medial malleolus.

q: What should patients be told before the block wears off?
o: Start oral analgesia before it wears off
why: Rebound pain after bone surgery can be severe; plan analgesia in advance.

q: What is the maximum dose of bupivacaine without adrenaline?
why: 2 mg/kg (about 150 mg in adults); combine doses with infiltration carefully.

q: Which comorbidity often affects foot and ankle surgery patients?
why: Diabetic neuropathy matters for wound healing and documenting baseline sensation.
